t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Seems  like certain gnomes lead to certain forests but theres no actual way to recognise what forest has the most amount of mushrooms so to me it seemed too over explained and overcomplicated as in the end it still makes the game look random.

vb_textbox.text: Hi Player,Goodluck,seems all warm colours take you to the "light" forest and cold colours take you to the "dark" forest,points seem to decrease on each forest as you keep playing through the game, what i done was change the forest i was going to when i hit +single digits.otherwise it seems the game is rather random and the multipliers seem to have no real value.again good luck
